title: Final Binding Energy
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the binding energy as E_b = mV_0^2/2hbar^2.

title: Condition for Bound State
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain that V_0 must be negative for a bound state to exist.

title: Schrödinger Equation Setup
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly set up the Schrödinger equation with E < 0 for bound states.

title: Integration Step
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the integration of the Schrödinger equation over a small interval around the delta function.

title: Wave Function Form
description: Optional Criteria: The student may provide the form of the wave function for the bound state, showing understanding of its behavior.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid sign errors in the expressions for k and the binding energy.

title: Normalization Mention
description: Optional Criteria: The student may mention the normalization condition for the wave function, indicating completeness of the solution.
